Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
